name: manage_binding
description: Search bindings, read guides, inspect section bindings, or update a binding through one consolidated facade. Binding mutations save working draft source only and never update the live page; a human must Publish or Update live in the Manual editor.

parameters.name: operation
parameters.description: Optional binding action. Omit operation or use search for discovery, then use guide, inspect, update_query, or update_template as needed.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search term for operation=search. Omit to return category summary.

parameters.name: section_id
parameters.description: Section ID for operation=inspect, update_query, or update_template.

parameters.name: query_args
parameters.description: Replacement binding query args for operation=update_query.

parameters.name: template_html
parameters.description: Replacement binding template markup for operation=update_template.

output.description: Plain text binding search or guide response with NEXT STEP guidance.
